name: Dario Picardi
bio: Born in Italy, Dario Picardi has spent more than fifteen years in beauty, consumer goods, real estate and international business, building and scaling premium brands and entering the U.S. and Latin American markets. He founded BIZ & STYLE in Miami in 2017.
seoDescription: Founder of BIZ & STYLE (Miami, 2017). Insights on international business, beauty, CPG, real estate and Americas expansion.
